evals.name: multi-key-rotation
evals.prompt: Хочу щоб мій застосунок переключався на наступний API ключ коли токени закінчуються
evals.expected_output: Claude implements key rotation: parse multiple keys, expand to chain nodes, failover on rate-limit
assertions: Parses multiple keys from one field (comma/newline)
Each key becomes a separate failover node
Continues to next node automatically, does not stop on error

evals.name: group-orchestration
evals.prompt: Зроби щоб кілька AI моделей працювали разом над запитом, кожна свою частину
evals.expected_output: Claude implements group orchestration with parallel/pipeline/synthesis modes and roles
assertions: Offers parallel, pipeline, and synthesis modes
Assigns roles (researcher, critic, synthesizer) with distinct system prompts
Synthesis combines outputs via a synthesizer node

evals.name: free-continuous-use
evals.prompt: Як зробити безперервне безкоштовне використання AI через ланцюг провайдерів?
evals.expected_output: Claude designs a provider chain with free providers, failover, and key rotation
assertions: Chains multiple free providers by tier
Failover keeps working when one provider's limit is hit

evals.name: custom-provider-config
evals.prompt: Дай користувачам підключати власний AI API через конфіг
evals.expected_output: Claude builds a config-driven custom provider (not eval), with getByPath response extraction
assertions: Config-driven provider, NOT eval of arbitrary code

version_note: evals authored at v1.0.0, revalidated against skill v1.4.2 on 2026-07-03
